Name: BetterFruitTrees
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
[heading]果树丰盈 BetterFruitTrees[/heading]

[center][size=5][b]Better Fruit Trees — Unlimited Fruit, One Shake[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][u]📖 模组介绍 / About This Mod[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]
In vanilla [i]Stardew Valley[/i], a mature fruit tree produces one fruit per day during its fruiting season, but the tree can only hold up to [b]3 fruits[/b] at a time. Once full, it stops producing.

[b]BetterFruitTrees[/b] changes this rule: after the tree fills with 3 fruits, it doesn't stop — it keeps accumulating fruit count. The tree still visually shows 3 fruits, and a number appears at the bottom-right corner of the 3rd fruit, showing the accumulated extra count.

[b][u]What it does:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Mature fruit trees keep producing every day with no 3-fruit cap.[/*]
[*]A number at the bottom-right of the 3rd fruit shows the accumulated count (number = total fruits - 2).[/*]
[*]Shake the tree once to harvest [b]all[/b] fruits accumulated on it.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Example:[/u][/b] A tree that has been mature for 10 days would normally hold 10 fruits. With this mod, the tree shows its original 3 fruits plus the number [b]"8"[/b] at the bottom-right of the 3rd fruit — shaking it once gives you all 10 fruits.

[line]

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
在《星露谷物语》原版中，成熟的果树在结果的季节每天会结出一颗果实，但树上的果实最多只会累积 [b]3 颗[/b]，满了之后便不再结果。

[b]果树丰盈[/b] 改变了这一规则：当树上结满 3 颗果实后，果树并不会停止结果，而是会继续累积果实数量。树上始终显示 3 颗果实，并在第 3 颗果实的右下角显示一个数字，代表累计的额外果实数量。

[b][u]玩法效果：[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] 成熟果树每天持续结果，不再有 3 颗上限。[/*]
[*]第 3 颗果实右下角显示累计数量（数字 = 总果数 - 2）。[/*]
[*]摇晃果树一次，即可收获树上累积的 [b]全部[/b] 果实。[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]示例：[/u][/b] 一棵成熟了 10 天的果树，按原版逻辑应有 10 颗果实。使用本模组后，树上显示原有的 3 颗果实，并在第 3 颗果实右下角显示数字 [b]「8」[/b]，摇晃一次即可获得全部 10 颗果实。

[line]

[size=5][b][u]⚙️ 使用方式 / How to Use[/u][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (version 4.0.0 or later).[/*]
[*]Put the [b]BetterFruitTrees[/b] folder into the game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and enjoy fruit trees that keep producing![/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*] 安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]（需要 4.0.0 或更高版本）。[/*]
[*]将 [b]BetterFruitTrees[/b] 文件夹放入游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹。[/*]
[*]启动游戏，享受持续结果的果树吧！[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][u]📦 兼容性 / Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]

[/list]
[list]

[/list]
